On October 26, 2026, MSGK distributed one share of MSGR Class A Common Stock and Class B Common Stock to its stockholders for every two shares of MSGK Class A Common Stock and MSGK Class B Common Stock, respectively (the "Distribution"), in a transaction exempt under Section 16 pursuant to Rule 16a-9 under the Exchange Act. As a result of the Distribution, MSGK no longer beneficially owns any shares of MSGR and consequently is no longer subject to the requirements of Section 16 of the Exchange Act with respect to MSGR.
